title: Animating a Backflip: blocking
summary: A rigged character (a pink mannequin standing in for the tutor's Mixamo model with a Rigify rig: IK legs with poles, feet that follow the IK handle or, switched to FK, the shin) animated pose to pose at 60 fps: standing, the wind-up (arms swung back, body down and forward), the take-off (arms up, body extended, on the toes), then the IK/FK switch keyed so the legs turn with the body in the air (the FK bones first keyed where the IK had them), the tuck upside down, legs reaching for the floor, the switch back to IK on the landing frame with the feet planted behind the start, the crouch, standing up. Rotations are Euler XYZ so the -360 degree flip goes the long way round. All keys constant: the blocking pass.

objects.name: Rig
objects.description: its armature with the backflip keys

expected_result: A pink mannequin on a grey floor, keyed in poses from standing through a backflip to a crouched landing half a metre behind the start; the render pops from pose to pose (constant keys).
